description: Canonical, machine-readable D1 migration manifest for WorkUnit OS. Two INDEPENDENT lanes (CONTROL_DB, TENANT_DB_DEFAULT). Existing migration SQL is IMMUTABLE after this manifest is introduced; changes are append-only. Each `sha256` is SHA-256 over the file bytes and is pinned. This file NEVER contains database IDs, secrets, identities, or seed values.

deferred.note: SQLite has no `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS`, so 0006 is not safely re-runnable and MUST NOT be part of an idempotent reproducible bootstrap lane. It is pinned here for digest-immutability (the manifest is canonical over every committed migration) and is applied once, separately, by an operator. Folding 0006 into a CREATE (a future idempotent rebuild) is tracked under Issue #155.
